🏃‍♂️ RUNNER X (ALPHA) 
Click. Run. Break your limits.

👍 Like the game and join the group



In RUNNER X, every click increases your speed. Run across the map, push your limits, and become the fastest runner in the server.

⚠️ ALPHA VERSION
This game is still in development. Bugs, balance changes, and updates may happen at any time.

~🔥 Features:

~Click to increase speed

~Progressive speed system

~Fast-paced and addictive gameplay

~Maps designed for running and speed

~💬 Your feedback is important! Help shape the future of RUNNER X.

~💥 How fast can you go?

💻 Supports Desktop, Mobile and Tablet players

~Premium? you have 2x speed!
